note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the soldier, the worker and the alate are all available, the worker is dimorphic; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. The specific name is OCR’d in the original as “assumuthi”, i.e. assmuthi.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule, pronotum and abdomen dark grey-brown; antennae, postclypeus and legs brown; wings dark, smoky brown; sternites paler, nearly white at the middle; pronotum with a pale brown T-shaped mark and oval shoulder spots. Head and body densely setose. Body length with wings 24.0–26.7 mm, without wings 11.4–14.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (to mandibular base 1.6–1.9 mm, width including the compound eyes 2.2–2.35 mm). Fontanelle minute, the area around it paler. Compound eyes medium-sized, circular (maximum diameter 0.53–0.58 mm, minimum diameter 0.48–0.53 mm); very close to the antennae, about 1/3 of their diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli wide, oval or circular (long diameter 0.21–0.25 mm, short diameter 0.20 mm); far from the compound eye, more than their long diameter. Antennae 19-segmented (occasionally 20); segment 3 generally shorter than segment 4, sometimes longer; segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, densely setose, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum trapezoidal (length 1.05–1.15 mm, width 2.0–2.25 mm); anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, anterior margin with a shallow median notch, posterior margin without a notch. Wings long, setose apically (forewing 20.0–22.5 mm, hindwing 18.5–20.0 mm); the radial band leaves the radius at about the middle; the membrane covered with coarse and rather wavy rod-like micro-sculpturing.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, antennae and labrum pale yellow to pale brown; antennae concolorous; mandibles brown to blackish brown; body straw yellow to pale yellowish brown. Head and pronotum sparsely setose, abdomen more densely setose. Body length 4.5–6.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides slightly convex (to mandibular base 1.44–1.70 mm, maximum width 1.07–1.35 mm); the anterior part is very slightly narrowed at the mandibular base (width at the mandibular base 0.78–0.98 mm, head constriction index 0.68–0.78). Antennae 16-segmented (occasionally 17); segment 4 shortest. Labrum lingulate (length 0.35 mm, width 0.30 mm); the anterior end narrowly rounded. Mandibles stout and short, apices weakly incurved (length 0.77–0.95 mm); slightly longer than half the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.51–0.57). Left mandible with 1 conspicuous, forwardly directed tooth situated slightly behind the apical 1/3; tooth distance 0.28–0.35 mm, tooth distance/mandible length index 0.33–0.37. Right mandible with a small tooth slightly below the level of the left mandibular tooth. Postmentum subrectangular (length 0.94–1.25 mm, maximum width 0.45–0.60 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.48–0.58 mm, width 0.75–0.95 mm); anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin weakly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow to pale yellowish brown; antennae paler; body length 3.5–4.0 mm. Head subquadrate and rounded (to mandibular base 1.05–1.20 mm, maximum width 1.25–1.33 mm). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shortest; segment 4 longer than segment 5. Postclypeus inflated and setose; less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25–0.35 mm, width 0.52–0.58 mm); anterior margin with a distinct median notch; posterior margin nearly straight or weakly concave. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, antennae 16-segmented (segment 4 shortest), the posterior part of the head slightly constricted; body length 2.8–3.3 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.80–0.90 mm, maximum head width 0.85–0.95 mm, pronotal length 0.25–0.35 mm, width 0.52–0.58 mm.
